title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.39223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without requiring training hardware that natively supports the target format; for example, it supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs, which lack FP4 Tensor Cores. The framework supports NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format; dense and mixture-of-experts models; and both full-parameter and LoRA-based training. It exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp without an additional lossy conversion step or added inference overhead. With QATFac

translated_title: QATFactory：一个面向大语言模型量化感知训练与蒸馏的多功能、部署对齐框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理正日益向低精度方向发展，以充分发挥硬件加速器的吞吐能力，但激进的后训练量化（PTQ）可能会降低模型质量。我们提出了QATFactory，这是一个用于部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）和强化学习（QARL）的开源框架。QATFactory在以BF16执行矩阵乘法的同时模拟部署时的量化，使模型能够适应量化噪声，而无需训练硬件原生支持目标格式；例如，它支持在缺乏FP4 Tensor Core的H100 GPU上进行NVFP4训练。该框架支持NVFP4、MXFP4以及llama.cpp的Q4_K格式；支持稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）模型；并支持全参数训练和基于LoRA的训练。它可以将检查点直接导出到vLLM和llama.cpp，无需额外的有损转换步骤，也不会增加推理开销。
tldr: QATFactory是一个开源的部署对齐训练框架，通过在BF16矩阵乘法上模拟部署时量化，使大语言模型能够在缺乏原生低精度硬件支持的GPU上进行NVFP4等格式的量化感知蒸馏与强化学习训练，并能直接导出至vLLM和llama.cpp且不带来额外推理开销。
en_tdlr: QATFactory is an open-source, deployment-aligned training framework that simulates deployment-time quantization (e.g., NVFP4, MXFP4, Q4_K) on top of BF16 matrix multiplications, enabling quantization-aware distillation and RL fine-tuning of LLMs on hardware lacking native low-precision support, with direct checkpoint export to vLLM and llama.cpp and no added inference overhead.
